metrics: With 500 million fans worldwide, the Real Madrid Football Club is among the world’s top sports franchises.
Today, club officials report digital revenue growth of 30 percent and could not be more positive about the club’s digital future.
Certainly there are millions of fans around the world that make it possible.
Founded in 1902, it has won more than 100 championships, including 12 European Cups, two FIFA Club World Cups and three Intercontinental Cups.
Club management knew that accomplishing a digital transformation could dramatically boost fan engagement.
“We wanted to connect with all the people who support Real Madrid in the world,” says Real Madrid CEO José Ángel Sánchez, noting that about 97 percent of fans reside outside of Spain.
And the largest market with just 11 percent of the fan base is in Indonesia, a third of the way around the world.
